description: This file appears to be a shell script intended for testing the behavior of the 'git pack-redundant' command. It includes function definitions, test setup, and multiple test cases that create git repositories, packs, and verify redundancy detection logic.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates a sequence of commits in a given repository and assigns their OIDs to provided variables.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack in the specified repository from provided commit data and assigns the pack ID to a variable.

methods.name: format_packfiles
methods.description: Formats the list of pack files extracted from the output of 'git pack-redundant' for easier comparison.
